parameters.name: second_line

create_transaction.description: Bill one price to a customer. With a customer, address and 'Manual' collection given, set Status to 'Billed' to invoice it immediately - Paddle emails the customer and, if the price recurs, creates a subscription for them right away, with no checkout involved. Leave Customer empty to create a draft with no one billed yet.
create_transaction.name: create_transaction

parameters.description: The price's ID, from 'List prices' or 'Create price'.
parameters.name: price_id

parameters.description: Only records for this customer. Leave empty for everyone.
parameters.name: customer_id

parameters.description: The customer's address ID, from 'List customer addresses'. Needed before a transaction can be billed (Paddle uses it to work out tax).
parameters.name: address_id

parameters.description: How many of the price to bill. Defaults to 1.
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.description: How Paddle gets paid. 'Manual' (Paddle invoices the customer) requires the address to have address line 1, city, region and postal code all set - 'Automatic' only needs the address's country.
parameters.name: collection_mode

options.label: Automatic - Paddle charges the customer's saved payment method
Manual - Paddle issues an invoice for the customer to pay

parameters.description: Required for 'Manual' collection: how long the customer has to pay.
parameters.name: payment_term_interval

parameters.description: Required for 'Manual' collection, alongside the interval - 14 with 'Day' is net-14.
parameters.name: payment_term_frequency

parameters.description: Leave empty to let Paddle decide. Set to 'billed' to invoice immediately.
parameters.name: status

options.label: Draft - missing items, a customer or an address
Ready - complete, but not yet billed

parameters.description: Overrides the price's own currency. Leave empty to use it.
parameters.name: currency_code

parameters.description: Arbitrary JSON to attach, such as {"internal_id": "123"}. Leave empty for none.
parameters.name: custom_data
